clue.text: The French support rough sketch for 7 across

parts.note: la is the French feminine word for 'the'

clue.text: Pop's failure to get help by the sound of it

clue.text: Rising among the Savoy Alps, idyllic spectacle

clue.text: I had come up with joke heard in review

definitions.meaning: to infer, as in 'I take it that'
